'''Herkan Base''' was a [[Golan III Space Defense NovaGun]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] during the era of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. The base was one of a series of orbital installations that were operated by [[Galactic Alliance Army]] around Nam Chorios to prevent unauthorized departures of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] from the world, in an attempt to keep the [[Death Seed]] plague from spreading from the planet, and Herkan Base was positioned to oversee the [[Crystal Valley (Nam Chorios)|Crystal Valley]] region of Nam Chorios. In [[44 ABY]], the station was infiltrated by the [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jysella Horn]], who brought the station under her control in order to serve the interests of the entity [[Abeloth]]. A short [[Time/Legends|time]] later, the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] [[Operation Shieldfall|sent]] forces to Nam Chorios and inserted some of their operatives aboard Nam Chorios' defensive installations to prevent the stations from being used against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], but the tribe were unsuccessful at placing Herkan Base's weapons systems under their influence. The [[New Jedi Order]]'s [[StealthX wing]] subsequently ambushed the Sith, and during the engagement, Herkan Base opened fire on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].
